No repo-wide exploratory sweep.

Implementation plan
1. Update `analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md`
   - Add the four `2026-05-22/23` docs to the processed-doc list and bump the processed-doc count.
   - Extend the outcome ledger beyond the current `2026-05-15` through `2026-05-21` range to cover:
     - `2026-05-22`
     - `2026-05-22-2`
     - `2026-05-23`
     - `2026-05-23-2`
   - Preserve the current bucket style (`actioned`, `already satisfied`, `deferred/risky`, etc.).
   - For docs with explicit IDs, keep the existing `<source doc> :: <recommendation id>` style.
   - For `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-05-23.md` (no `MERGE-*` / `REUSE-*` IDs), use stable heading-text labels or a minimal narrative subsection so every recommendation is still classified.
   - Recompute summary counts after repo-state rechecks.
   - Call out concrete code evidence for actioned items. Already-visible repo-state evidence worth using if unchanged at edit time:
     - `review_autofix` check-run wait default is now `300s`, with adaptive backoff on unchanged in-flight snapshots.
     - pass-2 review now splits small vs large diffs (`REVIEWER_PASS2_REASONING_SMALL=high`, `..._LARGE=xhigh`).
     - reviewer memory retrieval now passes PR title/body into `memory_retrieve`.
     - self-trigger skip remains opt-in while productive autofix continuation is default, so “turn skip on by default” recommendations should be recorded as deferred / alternative-design, not actioned.
   - Update the final assumptions note so it reflects that these four dated reports are being removed and the consolidated report is the retained repo-state artifact for this pass.

2. Update `README.md`
   - Fix the `CHECK_RUNS_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECS` row to match runtime default `300` and fallback clamp `300`.
   - Update the check-run polling description so it reflects adaptive backoff instead of a strictly fixed wait loop.
   - Update the two-pass reviewer description, and add or nearby-document the small/large pass-2 reasoning split if needed so the public contract matches live defaults.
   - Patch the `Autofix retrigger dedup` / self-triggered-skip prose so it matches `AUTOFIX_CONTINUATION_ENABLED=true`: productive `[ai-autofix]` commits dispatch a continuation run; ledger-only / legacy opt-in cases still skip.

3. Update `agents.md`
   - Fix the review-autofix model table rows so pass 1 still reflects hardcoded `xhigh`, but pass 2 reflects the current small/large diff split instead of the old “xhigh/xhigh” text.
   - Refresh any stale review-autofix line references in that table while keeping the edit minimal.

4. Delete the four processed source docs after the consolidated report is updated.

Data structures / contract surfaces affected
- `analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md`
  - processed-doc count/list
  - per-doc outcome ledger
  - summary totals
  - preserved-artifacts / assumptions notes
- `README.md`
  - review_autofix env-var table rows
  - `#autofix-retrigger-dedup` narrative
- `agents.md`
  - review_autofix rows in the models/defaults table
- No runtime API/schema changes; docs only.

Conflicts / edge cases
- `README.md` still documents `CHECK_RUNS_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECS=1200`; runtime is `300`.
- `README.md`’s autofix retrigger prose still describes the old post-commit skip behavior; continuation changed that path.
- `agents.md` still says the pass-2 gate is effectively `xhigh/xhigh`; runtime is now small=`high`, large=`xhigh`.
- `scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh` still has a stale inline `xhigh/xhigh` comment; public docs should follow workflow-exported runtime behavior, not that stale helper comment.
- The four `2026-05-22/23` files are the only remaining `analysis/workflow-optimization-*.md` files on disk, so delete them only after their outcomes are captured in the consolidated report.
- No explicit `files_touched` list was provided; safest assumption is that only the three named docs plus the four named deletions are writable.

Testing / verification
- Re-grep `README.md` / `agents.md` against `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` and `scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh` so documented defaults match runtime.
- Confirm the consolidated report now includes the four new source docs and updated totals.
- Confirm `find analysis -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'workflow-optimization-*.md'` returns no files after deletion.
- Confirm `analysis/validation-selftest-status.json` and `analysis/last_collection_timestamp.txt` are unchanged.
- Confirm `git diff --stat` shows only the three doc edits plus the four explicit deletions.

Assumptions / missing-context notes
- No clarification was required, so the issue body is the full contract.
- Because local history is shallow/grafted, “actioned / already satisfied / deferred” calls should be based on current repo state, not local `git log`.
